global_dependencies: Clock gate: DPORT_TIMERGROUP_CLK_EN (TIMG0), DPORT_TIMERGROUP1_CLK_EN (TIMG1) bits in DPORT_PERIP_CLK_EN_REG (0x3FF000C0).
TIMGn_TxCONFIG_REG (enable + prescaler) must be configured before the 64-bit counter (TIMGn_TxLO_REG/TIMGn_TxHI_REG) runs.

TIMGn_WDTWPROTECT_REG (write-protect key register) must be written with 0x50D83AA1 to unlock WDT configuration registers before modifying TIMGn_WDTCONFIG0-5_REG or feeding via TIMGn_WDTFEED_REG; writing any other value re-locks write protection.

IMPORTANT SCOPE NOTE: Chapter 11 'Watchdog Timers (WDT)' has NO registers of its own. The Main System Watchdog (MWDT) registers are the TIMGn_WDTCONFIG0-5_REG / TIMGn_WDTFEED_REG / TIMGn_WDTWPROTECT_REG entries already included in this file. The RTC Watchdog (RWDT) registers (RTC_CNTL_WDTCONFIG0-5_REG, RTC_CNTL_WDTFEED_REG, RTC_CNTL_WDTWPROTECT_REG) live in the RTC_CNTL peripheral (Chapter 9, Low-Power Management), which was not in the requested extraction scope and is not included here.
